using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 0) {

        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<int> parent(p);
    vector<int> size(p, 1);
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    
    function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        return parent[x] == x ? x : parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    };
    
    auto unite = [&](int x, int y) {
        x = find(x), y = find(y);
        if (x != y) {
            parent[y] = x;
            size[x] += size[y];
        }
    };
    
    for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        unite((1LL * k * i) % p, i);
    }
    
    ll ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        if (find(i) == i) {
            ans = (ans * mod_pow(k, size[i], p)) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    cout << ans;
    return 0;
